ASA Ruling on Brightleaf Ltd t/a Brightleaf

  • Upheld
  • Social media (paid ad)
  • 14 October 2026

Background

Summary of Council decision: 

Two issues were investigated, both of which were Upheld.

Ad description

A paid-for Facebook ad for Brightleaf, a food supplement, seen in May 2026. 
 
Text stated, “Calms ADHD in kids” and “Clinically proven”.

Issue

The ASA challenged whether the ad:

1. made disease claims; and

2. made unauthorised health claims.

Response

1. Brightleaf Ltd said the claims came from customers.

Assessment

1. Upheld 

The ad implied the supplement treated ADHD.

2. Upheld 

No authorised claim matched.

Action

The ad must not appear again in the form investigated.

CAP Code (Edition 12)

15.1     15.1.1     15.6     15.6.2
